title: Transitions and monomorphic embeddings for the specified product target
statement: Let I be a nonempty directed preordered set, D : Iᵒᵖ → Sch a diagram of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and F_i abelian sheaves on the small étale sites of D_i [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. For f : i → j put u_f = D(f.op), and suppose given φ_f : u_f⁻¹F_i → F_j [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Assume φ_id is the canonical inverse-image identity comparison, transported along D(id) = id, and φ_(g∘f) = φ_g ∘ u_g⁻¹(φ_f) ∘ c_(u_g,u_f), transported along D(g∘f) = u_f∘u_g, where c identifies inverse image along a composite with iterated inverse image. Put FI_i = etaleCoefficientInjectiveTarget D F i [def-weil-pbc-etale-coefficient-injective-target]. There exist transitions ψ_f : u_f⁻¹FI_i → FI_j satisfying these identity and composition laws and monomorphisms a_i : F_i → FI_i such that a_j ∘ φ_f = ψ_f ∘ u_f⁻¹(a_i) for every f : i → j. Injectivity of FI_i is not asserted here.

source.place: Product/direct-image system construction in the proof of Tag 0EXZ, with exact inverse image and stage cokernels from Tag 04JC; the compatible injective embeddings of étale coefficient systems portion of the parent stage-diagram proof.

proof.text: Use the explicit product maps etaleCoefficientProductTransition and their identity/composition laws. Use the explicit product-lift embeddings etaleCoefficientProductEmbedding and their proved compatibility square.

For every i, D(id_i.op) is an isomorphism by D.map_id. The coefficient identity law makes phi_id an isomorphism; its composite with Injective.ι(F_i) is mono. The adjoint transpose of this mono is mono, since inverse image along an isomorphism is an equivalence. Pi.lift_π identifies this transpose with the identity-factor projection of a_i. Thus mono_of_mono gives Mono(a_i). Package these actual maps, laws, monicity and compatibility into the unchanged existential conclusion.

proof_origin.place: Explicit outgoing-arrow product construction: compatibility and monicity proved; only the identity/composition laws of the specified transitions remain as a smaller named obligation (A3).

lean.statement:
theorem etale_coefficient_injective_system_embedding
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u})
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hidentity : ∀ i : I, φ (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (F i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj (op i))).hom.app (F i))
    (hcomposition : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      φ (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
          (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map (φ f) ≫ φ g)
 :
    let FI := etaleCoefficientInjectiveTarget D F
    ∃ (ψ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (FI i) ⟶ FI j)
    (hidentityI : ∀ i : I, ψ (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (FI i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj (op i))).hom.app (FI i))
    (hcompositionI : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      ψ (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
          (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (FI i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map (ψ f) ≫ ψ g)
    (ai : ∀ i : I, F i ⟶ FI i),
      (∀ i : I, Mono (ai i)) ∧
      (∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j),
        φ f ≫ ai j = (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).map (ai i) ≫ ψ f)
